units.source_text: 此时紫夫人病故的消息，已经传遍各处。

en.t: By this time, the news that Lady Murasaki had died of illness had already spread everywhere.
Unexpectedly, many people came to offer their condolences.

units.source_text: 源氏嫌其不祥，心甚懊恼。

en.t: Genji found this ominous and was deeply distressed.

units.source_text: 今日贺茂祭行列归来，王侯公卿都前往观礼。

en.t: Today the Kamo Festival procession was returning, and princes, nobles, and court officials had all gone to watch it.

units.source_text: 他们在归途闻知此事，有人即景戏言道：

en.t: On their way back, they heard the news, and someone joked on the spot:

units.source_text: 这样一个荣华盖世的幸福儿死了，真好比太阳失去了光彩，

en.t: For such a supremely blessed person, surrounded by unmatched splendor, to die is truly like the sun losing its radiance,

units.source_text: 怪不得今天小雨霏霏了。”

en.t: so no wonder a fine rain has been falling today.”
Another person said in a low voice:

units.source_text: “如此十全无缺的人，必然不能长生。

en.t: “Someone so perfect and without flaw surely could not live long.
As the old poem says so well:
‘That is why the cherry blossom crowns all flowers.’

units.source_text: 这个完人如果长生在世，尽情享受人间幸福，

en.t: If this perfect person had lived long in the world and enjoyed every earthly happiness to the full,
everyone else would have had to suffer for her sake.

units.source_text: 自今以后，那位二品公主便可专宠，

en.t: From now on, that Second-Rank Princess will be able to enjoy his favor all to herself,

units.source_text: 像从前在父亲身边时一样幸福了。

en.t: and be as happy as she was long ago at her father’s side.

units.source_text: 多年来屈居人下，真是难为了她！”

en.t: For so many years she had to live beneath another; it truly must have been hard for her!”
